scope: Complete pinned API and queue/event state machine with controlled atomic/FIFO/SDH boundaries; SVC40/41, sync/asynchronous completion, busy/error handling, retries, exact event payloads, queue chaining, operation records, copy/read/map, cold state and saved registers
limitations: FIFO/atomic/SDH callbacks and flash SVC results are controlled, not real concurrency, SoftDevice acceptance or persistent flash proof.
Canonical bool flags and bounded completing queue scenarios only; synchronous zero-page erasure/nonterminating huge queues and reentrant callbacks remain unproven.
Observer record bytes/positions are authenticated; complete dispatcher wiring and original instruction/link identity remain gates. Whole image/hardware are not proven.
